history: all earlier valid answers of the same observed respondent; strictly before current date
state_features: last valid answer nonzero-bin bucket 1/2/3-4/5-10; training quartiles of its official Q9_iqr and max bin probability; missing/first-observed explicit
auxiliary: cold/no history versus 1-2 versus 3+ prior observations
weighting: survey weight normalized within month; months equally weighted; training weights rescaled to mean one solely for fixed pseudocount scale

person_cluster_bootstrap.scope: conditional on fitted training tables and observed evaluation months; renormalize weights within each resampled month

month_block_bootstrap.scope: separate paired circular-block monthly-loss diagnostic; not a joint two-way or official complex-survey interval

sensitivity_reuse: existing 767 valid confidence-trial model answers and 5/10 rounding outputs; reproduce equal-sample empirical median/IQR/W1/variance before and after; no new fitting choices or simulations
exposure: Full-span descriptive grid/age statistics and four development experiments have already been viewed. These are time-separated checks for this fixed method, not a completely unseen project test.
limits: Observed grid is not an identified psychological trait.
Conditioning on previous belief shape does not establish a causal reporting effect.
Returning respondents and valid answers are selected; no-history means first observable here, not necessarily first SCE interview.
Private previous questionnaire data are not PIT B inputs.
Parameters are fixed before new evaluation and are not selected from this run.
